answer: A single document can be printed; a decade must be lived. Court filing receipt with clerk-stamped docket number demands the lived decade: a docket the court clerk stamped and filed in 2016. The sonnet of the decade is its boredom - the same small fee, the same form, repeated until nobody remembers why it started. Forging it means inventing ten years of boredom, and the delta of the invention is consistency: every date in order, every amount matching. The island that betrays the forgery is the one year that looks too tidy.
